name: bulk-paste-field
title: Bulk paste field
description: Paste a list of emails, SKUs or URLs and see what was understood: valid, invalid and duplicate counts, the bad lines listed, and one-click tidying.
docs: value and onValueChange speak the text, one item per line; onItemsChange speaks the clean list (normalised, valid, each once, in order, up to max) after a pause in the typing and whenever a tidy action changes it. validate gets the normalised line and returns true or nothing when it is fine, false for the default reason, or the reason in words; normalise decides what a line is for the duplicate check and the list (trim and lower-case an address, upper-case a SKU), and by default only trims. Under the field a summary reads 38 valid, 2 invalid, 5 duplicates in a polite live region that is worked out once the typing pauses, never on every key, together with the panel and the marks beside the line numbers; the check is one pass with a Set, so ten thousand lines take a few milliseconds. The lines that need attention (invalid ones and, with max, the lines past the limit) are listed in a compact panel, five at a time with a Show more, each a button that selects the line and scrolls it into view. Remove duplicates, Remove invalid and, with max, Keep the first N each rewrite the text in one click, keep every other line in order, and offer Undo. A paste that holds commas, semicolons or tabs becomes one item per line through the browser's own insertText, so the text keeps its undo history; a plain column pastes as it is. The line numbers are drawn only for the lines in view, with fixed pixel metrics, so they follow the scrolling and stay on their lines. It is a plain textarea, so it stays fast with thousands of lines. A change to validate or normalise is picked up on the next edit. name goes on the textarea, rows sets how many lines are visible, label and hideLabel name the field, and labels renames every phrase.
